model: exact canonical local representatives for E0=78 K2,3 and C6
vertex_encoding: symbol labels are unordered pairs from 0..13; support is symbol//2; outer_index follows scratch_general_exact_sat.coordinates(); one-based graph vertex is outer_index+16 (vertices 1..15 are root/inner).
canonical_encoding: bit i corresponds to the i-th lexicographic pair from combinations(range(24),2) in local_vertex_order; representatives minimize this integer under all induced actions.
